title: Beyond Accuracy: A Decision-Theoretic Framework for Allocation-Aware Healthcare AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on resource allocation and utility estimation in healthcare AI. While it includes a brief section on governance and ethical considerations (Section 6.3), this does not constitute a primary component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The core evaluation is focused on allocation efficiency and realised utility in a synthetic simulation, rather than ethical or moral reasoning.
